## File: main-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Application main menu; entry point for bootstrapping, find,
## edit, and verify workflows exposed to the user via UI frameworks.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.main
  name: "Main Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Application main menu for bootstrapping, find, edit, and verify workflows."

udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main"
kind: menu
type: "menu"
title: "Main Menu"
header:
  type: "runtime_state"

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.run-bootstrap-sequence"
    label: "Run Bootstrap Sequence"
    description: "Initialize Universe ingestion, archive, and registry state."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-bootstrap-run"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
    visibility_condition: "bootstrap_mode"

  - key: "0"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.quit"
    label: "Quit"
    description: "Exit the application."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-quit"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
    visibility_condition: "initialized"

  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.find"
    label: "Find & Select"
    description: "Search for files, preview results, and perform diff operations."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search-results"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.find"
    visibility_condition: "initialized"

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.edit"
    label: "Create & Edit"
    description: "Create new objects, update fields, conform to reference objects, and export."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-edit-multi"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.edit"
    visibility_condition: "initialized_and_vile_ingested"

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.edit-locked-until-vile-ingestion"
    label: "Edit (Locked until Vile ingestion)"
    description: "Create/Edit remains locked until tooling.vile is ingested."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-edit-multi"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
    visibility_condition: "initialized_and_vile_not_ingested"

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.verify"
    label: "Verify"
    description: "Validate objects, run semantic substrate operations, apply version changes, and run diff panels."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-verify-multi"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.verify"
    visibility_condition: "initialized"

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.main.settings"
    label: "Settings"
    description: "Configure folder paths, naming conventions, export rules, and registry behavior."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.settings"
    visibility_condition: "initialized"
